title: Healthcare-associated mpox outbreak among neonates and infants
description: 29 laboratory-confirmed cases (8 deaths, 28% case fatality rate) among neonates/infants in NICUs, March 2026. Traced to healthcare facilities in Khairpur, Karachi, and Sukkur. Clade Ib MPXV. Reported to WHO under IHR (2005) on 5 April 2026.
source_name: WHO Mpox Multi-country External Situation Report No. 65

title: National Cholera Control Plan 2025-2028 launched
description: Pakistan MoH and WHO launched a national plan targeting 90% mortality reduction by 2030. Cited annual average of 21,000+ suspected and 250 confirmed cholera cases (Jan 2023-Jul 2025). 2022 floods triggered 370,000+ suspected cases.

title: Polio resurgence reported: 73 cases in 2024 vs 1 in 2021
description: Washington Post reporting on WHO/Pakistan polio program data showing sharp resurgence, attributed partly to militant attacks on vaccination teams.

title: Chikungunya resurgence noted globally, Pakistan at 2024-comparable rates
description: 1,596 suspected and 67 confirmed CHIKV cases reported Pakistan+Somalia combined, Jan-Sep 2025, part of a wider global resurgence across 40 countries.
